PELVIC FLOOR EXCERCISE-
Pelvic floor exercises (Kegels) strengthen the muscles that support your bladder and bowels. To locate the muscles, imagine stopping the flow of urine or trying to prevent passing gas. Empty your bladder: Always start with an empty bladder to prevent discomfort.

We are truly grateful to Pooja Hospital for the wonderful care we received. Our baby boy was delivered normally on 27 July 2025, and we cannot thank Dr. Pooja and the entire staff enough for the exceptional support throughout the journey.

As a family, we were extremely tense and panicked seeing the mother in labour pain. At one point, we even insisted on a C-section. Their confidence and guidance gave us immense strength.

Because of their expertise and care, we were blessed with a healthy baby boy through normal delivery. The support we received during and after delivery was truly outstanding.

A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Pooja and the entire Pooja Hospital staff for making this experience smooth, safe, and memorable. Highly recommended! 💐👶💖

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Pooja Hospital for my wife and I must say it was an outstanding experience from start to finish. As someone who is particular about healthcare services, I was truly impressed by the high standards maintained at this facility.

Consultation & Expertise
Dr.Pooja Shah is not only highly experienced but also incredibly compassionate. She took the time to explain every detail, answered all our concerns with patience, and made us feel completely at ease. Her diagnostic approach was thorough, and her confidence gave us immense reassurance.

Facilities & Cleanliness
The hospital is spotless and well-organized. From the waiting lounge to the consultation rooms and diagnostic areas, everything is meticulously maintained. We also appreciated the availability of advanced ultrasound facility which made the process smoother and quicker.

Staff Behaviour
The nursing and administrative staff were courteous, helpful, and respectful throughout my visit. My wife never felt rushed or ignored—something that’s rare in busy hospitals today. Appointments were well-managed, minimizing wait times.

Comfort & Privacy
They truly value patient privacy. Every procedure, including sonography and examinations, was carried out with professionalism and discretion. We felt safe and respected at every step.

Overall, I highly recommend Pooja Hospital to anyone looking for gynecological or women’s health services. It’s rare to find a place where medical excellence meets compassionate care so seamlessly. Truly deserving of 5 stars!

featured_reviews.name: shreya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took my mother to Dr. Prakshal for a consultation, and from the very beginning, he made us feel at ease. He listened carefully to all our concerns and then clearly explained the need for surgery, the urgency, and what to expect during the procedure. He patiently answered all our questions, leaving us well-informed and reassured.

Dr. Prakshal, being a trained laparoscopic surgeon, performed the surgery himself. The procedure went smoothly and without complications. After the surgery, he visited my mother, ensured she was doing well, and offered us much-needed comfort and clarity.

While the medical center itself is a bit old and could benefit from improved hygiene, the staff were very helpful and supportive throughout. Their care and attentiveness made a big difference in our overall experience.

Overall, we had a smooth experience, and I would recommend Dr. Prakshal for his professionalism, skill, and compassionate approach.

featured_reviews.name: Vaibhavi Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the pleasure of experiencing exceptional care at Pooja Hospital under the guidance of Dr. Krishnakumari. After suffering three miscarriages with my previous doctor (Dr.Saloni Suchak), I sought a second opinion and was fortunate to find Dr. Krishnakumari. Her thorough examination and meticulous approach helped identify the underlying cause of my previous miscarriages, which had gone undetected earlier.

Under her expert care and supervision, I was blessed with a beautiful baby girl, and what's more, I had a successful normal delivery. I highly recommend Dr. Krishnakumari and Pooja Hospital for their expertise and compassionate care. My only advice would be to be patient, as the hospital can get busy, and to have faith in the doctors, who are truly experienced and skilled professionals
